fusions.name: Lead the Column
fusions.desc: Stamps down at the head of the march, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Trample Underfoot
fusions.desc: Stamps on a target at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage and consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Hobnailed Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Road-Hardened
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover gives you a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
